integrity: The algebraic proof is independent of finite modular-rank experiments. General spectral decomposition and Krylov reduction are credited to primary prior work. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: A homogeneous finite perfect rooted tree with branching at least two, uniform nonzero real hopping, one strictly positive one-site loss and a maximally mixed single-particle input; no claim for arbitrary sites, disorder, multiple traps, finite-time capture rates or coined walks. Closely related spectral and Krylov results are explicitly antecedents; novelty remains subject to independent priority review.
title: A totient law for one-leaf quantum absorption on perfect rooted trees
